issue_context.title: Regression in 252: bootcl fails to probe PART_ENTRY_SCHEME on /dev/dm-0
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

252.1

### Used distribution

Arch Linux

### Linux kernel version used

6.0.6

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

bootctl

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

_No response_

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

After systemd update from **251.7** to **252.1** invocation of `bootctl` command fails at probing `/dev/dm-0` (encrypted LUKS partition).

In the result `bootctl` command is unusable. I guess it should just ignore encrypted LUKS devices when it does probing?

In below examples my EFI partition is mounted at `/boot/efi`.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

_No response_

### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

```sh
# /usr/bin/bootctl --path=/boot/efi --no-variables update
/dev/dm-0: Failed to probe PART_ENTRY_SCHEME: Input/output error

$ bootctl -p
/boot/efi
dm-0: Failed to query ID_PART_ENTRY_SCHEME: No such file or directory

$ bootctl -x
dm-0: Failed to query ID_PART_ENTRY_SCHEME: No such file or directory
/boot/efi
```
